name: @battuta/plugin-pitch-reference
description: A recording's pitch, detected with YIN and traced over every measure of the score and over the whole file, with the written pitch on the same axis — the first reference layer.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
./yin and ./align are exported so the detector and the alignment maths can be read from outside the package without reaching into src/ by path; nothing in the app imports them.

dependencies: @battuta/api and react (a panel and an overlay render into host areas) and nothing else of the workspace. No DSP library: YIN is ~120 lines and a dependency would have to be allowlisted for one consumer.
